semiconductor_relevance: High — WIKA provides specialized pressure measurement solutions critical for gas delivery systems in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: WIKA International Trading (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. is a leader in pressure and temperature measurement, offering high-precision instruments tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their UHP gauge and transducer product lines are designed for applications requiring the highest purity standards, ensuring reliable performance in gas delivery systems.

regional_presence.China: WIKA operates in China, providing localized support and services for the semiconductor industry.
